_comment: Binaries and payloads actually embedded in the shipped app bundle (not installed on demand). Read by scripts/release/generate-notices.py to build THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES. Keep in sync with what Contents/Resources actually contains.

bootstrapBinaries.notes: Bundled bootstrap binary used to create and manage per-tool conda environments under ~/.lungfish. Version and sha256 are sourced from third-party-tools-lock.json bootstrap.micromamba.

managedToolNotes.note: LGE uses a separately maintained custom fork of upstream PrimalScheme3 v3.3.0, not an upstream release (https://github.com/dhoconno/primalscheme3-lge). The exact custom version, release artifact checksum, and fork/upstream revisions are pinned in third-party-tools-lock.json (packTools[primalscheme3].pythonRuntime). The fork adds a selectable terminal-missing-data policy; its Python observed-only discovery path differs from the upstream Rust legacy path. Upstream source: https://github.com/artic-network/primalscheme3, licensed GPL-3.0. Upstream authors retain their copyrights; modified source, attribution and the complete license are available in the public fork. This tool is installed into a separate managed environment on demand and is not included in the app executable. LGE's MIT license does not replace this tool's GPL license.

containerizationPayloads.sourceOffer: Written offer: the exact kernel source and build configuration used to produce this image are available on request to dhoconno@wisc.edu for three years from the date of this release, and are also obtainable from the upstream Apple Containerization project's kernel build recipe at https://github.com/apple/containerization/tree/main/kernel for the pinned containerization revision recorded in Package.resolved.

containerizationPayloads.notes: ARM64 Linux kernel boot image (Ubuntu 22.04 toolchain) used as the VM kernel for the Apple Containerization runtime that executes Nextflow/TaxTriage pipelines in an isolated Linux VM. Built from the upstream apple/containerization kernel recipe. GPL-2.0 requires this notice and a source offer; see sourceOffer.

containerizationPayloads.notes: Minimal Linux init rootfs (vminitd/vmexec) shipped by the apple/containerization SwiftPM package and re-embedded here for the container VM.
